critique.evidence: Across desktop, tablet, and mobile, automated scans report no confirmed WCAG violations, no viewport overflow, and no touch-target violations. However, color contrast remains seriously incomplete for 20 vault nodes at every viewport because gradient/obscured backgrounds prevented measurement, including headings, explanatory text, status badges, the evidence toggle, and disclosure text. No measured keyboard traversal, focus order/visibility, control activation, focus management, or reduced-motion evidence was provided, so these required areas cannot pass.
critique.fix: Measure and correct contrast against the rendered gradient backgrounds to at least WCAG AA ratios, including all muted text and controls. Add Playwright evidence for complete keyboard-only traversal, visible focus, logical order, Enter/Space activation of the evidence toggle, and absence of traps. Test prefers-reduced-motion: reduce and verify that nonessential animation/transitions are disabled. Re-run these checks at all three viewports.
